measurement_guidance.actual_capital: Do not equate exchange inflows/outflows with new capital. Reconcile fiat/stablecoin mint-redemption, ETF creations/redemptions, OTC settlement, venue quote-asset balances, executed aggressive order flow (CVD), order-book depth and market-maker inventory.
measurement_guidance.stablecoin_xrp_relationship: Stablecoin inflows alongside XRP outflows may indicate de-risking or settlement preference, but only if timestamp, venue universe, wallet labels and transfer classes are synchronized.
measurement_guidance.etf_relationship: ETF holdings and exchange balances represent different populations and transfer mechanisms; do not net them without fund-level and wallet-level reconciliation.
